guide.summary: Internal tool, same organization only (self-serve, wait none); Public agent, restricted Gmail scopes (app review, wait several weeks, no fixed figure); Public app, only sensitive scopes (app review, wait 3-5 business days typical).
guide.verdict: Easiest: Internal tool, same organization only (self-serve, wait none). Hardest: Public agent, restricted Gmail scopes (app review, wait several weeks, no fixed figure).

composio.note: Composio's managed Gmail app works for prototypes. For production, create an auth config with your own client ID and secret.

need_own_app.answer: For production, yes. The managed app shows Composio's name on the consent screen, uses default scopes and shares quota across all Composio users.
reasons: Consent screen shows your brand, not Composio
Custom scopes instead of Composio's defaults
Shorter polling intervals than the 15-minute managed minimum

prerequisites.title: Verified domain for app homepage
prerequisites.detail: The homepage must be on a domain you own and have verified, and must link the privacy policy.

prerequisites.title: Demo video and scope justification
prerequisites.detail: Prepare a video of the full flow including the OAuth grant, and a justification for each scope explaining why narrower scopes won't work.

steps.title: Create Google OAuth app, internal type
steps.detail: Create the app in your Google Cloud project tied to your organization.

steps.title: Verify homepage domain and privacy policy
steps.detail: Host the homepage on a domain you have verified and link the privacy policy.

steps.title: Draft scope justifications
steps.detail: Write per-scope justification and why narrower scopes are insufficient.

steps.title: Prepare demo script
steps.detail: Draft a script showing the end-to-end flow including the OAuth grant.

steps.title: Record demo and submit verification
steps.detail: Record the video and click submit in Google Cloud.

steps.title: Complete security assessment with assessor
steps.detail: Engage a Google-approved assessor and complete the assessment.

steps.title: Wait for restricted-scope verification
steps.detail: Google says this can take several weeks.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config via API
steps.detail: Use your own client ID and secret, and copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard into your Google OAuth app.
steps.done_when: Auth config created and a test connection works

traps.title: Gmail mail-access scopes are restricted
traps.detail: Reading, composing and modifying mail all sit in the restricted tier. Only gmail.send is sensitive and only gmail.labels is non-sensitive.

traps.title: Security assessment repeats yearly
traps.detail: Google emails you when recertification is due. Reverification and a new assessment are needed at least every 12 months.

traps.title: 100 new user cap while unverified
traps.detail: An app showing the unverified screen is capped at 100 new users in total.

traps.title: Managed app shows Composio branding
traps.detail: Users see Composio on the consent screen, not your app. Not suited to production.

traps.title: Testing status allows test users only
traps.detail: An app in Testing is available only to test users you add manually.
